name: application-venue-section-map
title: Venue Section Map
description: Zoomed-out venue/stadium map of clickable seating-section blocks, colored by price tier, with a tier-to-price legend and a sold-out state.
useWhen: Letting a user choose a general seating section (e.g. Floor, Lower, Upper) in a large venue before drilling into individual seats.
You need a price-tier legend so users understand what each section color means.
Distinct from Seat Map Selector, which lets a user pick individual numbered seats within one small section rather than choosing among a venue's sections.
avoidWhen: The venue is small enough that individual seat selection is the first step — use Seat Map Selector directly.
There's only one price tier or one section — a simple ticket-tier list (see Ticket Tier Selector) is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: Sections lay out in a 3-column grid that stays legible down to narrow viewports; the legend wraps onto multiple lines rather than truncating.
accessibility: Each section button has an aria-label stating its name, price tier, price, and selected/sold-out state, since tier is otherwise conveyed by color alone.
Sold-out sections are real disabled buttons, not just visually muted, removing them from the tab order.
The selected section is marked with aria-pressed="true" in addition to a visual ring.

variants.title: Venue Section Map
variants.description: 3x3 grid of Floor/Lower/Upper sections across Platinum/Gold/Silver tiers, one selected section, one sold-out section, and a legend.
accessibility: Sold-out section is a real disabled button; selected section carries aria-pressed="true".

variants.title: Venue Section Map (Dark)
variants.description: The same section grid adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Tier color contrast and sold-out muting remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
